results.title: 'We are Gen Z is the new mera baap kaun hai': Omar Abdullah slams tourist ruckus at Kargil checkpoint
results.description: Jammu and Kashmir Chief Minister Omar Abdullah took to social media platform X to criticize the growing use of the phrase "We are Gen Z" as a form of intimidation, comparing it to the classic entitlement line "Jaante nahin ho mera baap kaun hai".
